blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Secretary Ma. Cristina Roque on Monday declined to disclose possible trade agreements or commitments that could emerge from United States President Donald Trump’s visit to the Philippines. According to Roque, the government would release details after Trump’s bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. Asked what trade deals could be initiated or pursued during Trump’s visit, Roque said she could not yet discuss the matter. “I cannot disclose that at this time, but definitely once we have it, we will give out information,” she told reporters at a press briefing on the […]...
